AdminChanged(address,address).details: Emitted when the admin account has changed.

BeaconUpgraded(address).details: Emitted when the beacon is changed.

Initialized(uint8).details: Triggered when the contract has been initialized or reinitialized.

Paused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is triggered by `account`.

Unpaused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is lifted by `account`.

Upgraded(address).details: Emitted when the implementation is upgraded.

params.guardians: The list of addresses of the pause guardians to be added.

confirmTransferOwnership().details: This is real transfer ownership in second step by appointed account

getImplementation().details: The function returns the value stored in the implementation storage slot.

returns._0: The address of the implementation contract.

getVersion().details: Increase number when implementation inside source code is different that implementation deployed on Mainnet

params.account: The address of the account to be checked.

returns._0: true if account is a pause guardian.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

proxiableUUID().details: Implementation of the ERC1822 {proxiableUUID} function. This returns the storage slot used by the implementation. It is used to validate the implementation's compatibility when performing an upgrade. IMPORTANT: A proxy pointing at a proxiable contract should not be considered proxiable itself, because this risks bricking a proxy that upgrades to it, by delegating to itself until out of gas. Thus it is critical that this function revert if invoked through a proxy. This is guaranteed by the `notDelegated` modifier.

params.guardians: The list of addresses of the pause guardians to be removed.

upgradeTo(address).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.

upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`, and subsequently execute the function call encoded in `data`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.

AppointedToTransferOwnership(address).notice: Emitted when account is appointed to transfer ownership

OraclePublisherUpdaterAdded(address).notice: event emitted when OraclePublisher Updater is added by Owner

OraclePublisherUpdaterRemoved(address).notice: event emitted when OraclePublisher Updater is removed by Owner

PauseGuardiansAdded(address[]).notice: Emitted when new pause guardian is added

PauseGuardiansRemoved(address[]).notice: Emitted when pause guardian is removed

addPauseGuardians(address[]).notice: Adds a pause guardian to the list of guardians. Function available only for the Owner.

getImplementation().notice: Retrieves the address of the implementation contract for UUPS proxy.

isPauseGuardian(address).notice: Checks if given account is a pause guardian.

pause().notice: Pauses current smart contract. It can be executed only by the Owner.

removePauseGuardians(address[]).notice: Removes a pause guardian from the list of guardians. Function available only for the Owner.

removeUpdater(address).notice: Removes Updater. Function available only to Owner.

unpause().notice: Unpauses current smart contract. It can be executed only by the Owner
